datasets.name: ds_usage_daily
queryLines: WITH scoped AS (   SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily   WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) ), base AS (   SELECT * FROM scoped   WHERE event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max     AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model)) ), sim_rate AS (   SELECT CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS rate  FROM scoped WHERE destination_model = :param_sim_model ), daily AS (   SELECT event_date, SUM(total_tokens) AS day_tokens FROM base GROUP BY event_date ) SELECT   b.event_date,   b.destination_model,   CAST(SUM(b.cost_usd) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd,   SUM(b.total_tokens) AS total_tokens,   CAST(MIN(d.day_tokens) * MIN(s.rate) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost_usd FROM base b JOIN daily d ON b.event_date = d.event_date CROSS JOIN sim_rate s GROUP BY b.event_date, b.destination_model ORDER BY b.event_date

datasets.name: ds_kpis
queryLines: WITH scoped AS (   SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily   WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) ), base AS (   SELECT * FROM scoped   WHERE event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max     AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model)) ), sim_rate AS (   SELECT CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS rate   FROM scoped WHERE destination_model = :param_sim_model ) SELECT   CAST(SUM(base.cost_usd) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS real_cost,   CAST(SUM(base.total_tokens) * MIN(sim_rate.rate) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost,   CAST(SUM(base.total_tokens) * MIN(sim_rate.rate) - SUM(base.cost_usd) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS savings FROM base CROSS JOIN sim_rate

datasets.name: ds_compare
datasets.displayName: Comparativo do período: real vs. modelo único
queryLines: WITH scoped AS (   SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily   WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) ), base AS (   SELECT * FROM scoped   WHERE event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max     AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model)) ), totals AS (SELECT SUM(total_tokens) AS tt, SUM(cost_usd) AS rc FROM base), rates AS (   SELECT destination_model, CAST(SUM(cost_usd) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS rate  FROM scoped GROUP BY destination_model ) SELECT '0 · Real (mix atual)' AS scenario, CAST((SELECT rc FROM totals) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd UNION ALL SELECT concat('Só ', r.destination_model) AS scenario,        CAST((SELECT tt FROM totals) * r.rate AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd FROM rates r WHERE array_contains(:param_compare_models, r.destination_model) ORDER BY scenario

datasets.name: ds_harness
queryLines: WITH scoped AS (   SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily   WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name)) ), base AS (   SELECT event_date, workspace_id, endpoint_name, destination_model, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd   FROM scoped   WHERE event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max     AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ), harness AS (   SELECT DATE(event_time) AS event_date, CAST(workspace_id AS STRING) AS workspace_id, endpoint_name,          LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(destination_model, '[ .]+', '-')) AS destination_model,          CASE            WHEN url LIKE '%/cursor/v1/chat/completions%' THEN 'Cursor'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%claude%' THEN 'Claude Code'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%gemini%' THEN 'Gemini CLI'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%codex%' THEN 'Codex CLI'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%opencode%' THEN 'OpenCode'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE 'pi/%' THEN 'Pi'            WHEN lower(user_agent) LIKE '%copilot%' THEN 'Github Copilot'            ELSE 'Outros / API direta'          END AS harness,          SUM(total_tokens) AS htok   FROM system.ai_gateway.usage   WHERE destination_model IS NOT NULL     AND (invocation_metadata.source != 'AI_QUERY' OR invocation_metadata.source IS NULL)     AND (service_type != 'MCP_SERVICE' OR service_type IS NULL)   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ), grp AS (   SELECT event_date, workspace_id, endpoint_name, destination_model, SUM(htok) AS mtok   FROM harness GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) SELECT h.harness,        CAST(SUM(CAST(base.cost_usd AS DOUBLE) * h.htok / NULLIF(g.mtok, 0)) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd FROM base JOIN harness h ON base.event_date = h.event_date AND base.workspace_id = h.workspace_id   AND base.endpoint_name = h.endpoint_name AND base.destination_model = h.destination_model JOIN grp g ON base.event_date = g.event_date AND base.workspace_id = g.workspace_id   AND base.endpoint_name = g.endpoint_name AND base.destination_model = g.destination_model GROUP BY h.harness ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_provider_sim
queryLines: WITH ref AS (SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_aa_model_ref), real AS (   SELECT destination_model, SUM(input_tokens) inp, SUM(output_tokens) outp,          SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite   FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily   WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name))     AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max     AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))   GROUP BY 1 ), real_aa AS (   SELECT r.*, ref.intelligence r_intel, ref.price_input rp_in, ref.price_output rp_out,          ref.price_cache_read rp_cr, ref.price_cache_write rp_cw   FROM real r JOIN ref ON r.destination_model = ref.slug_norm ), base AS (   SELECT '0 · Mix atual (direto)' AS scenario,          SUM((GREATEST(inp - cread - cwrite, 0) * rp_in + cread * COALESCE(rp_cr, rp_in)               + cwrite * COALESCE(rp_cw, rp_in) + outp * rp_out) / 1e6) AS cost_usd   FROM real_aa ), cand AS (   SELECT ra.destination_model, ra.inp, ra.outp, ra.cread, ra.cwrite, ep.provider target_provider,          ep.price_input, ep.price_output, ep.price_cache_read pcr, ep.price_cache_write pcw,          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.destination_model, ep.provider                             ORDER BY ABS(ep.intelligence - ra.r_intel), ep.intelligence DESC) rn   FROM real_aa ra JOIN ref ep ON TRUE ), per_prov AS (   SELECT concat('Só ', target_provider) AS scenario, target_provider,          SUM((GREATEST(inp - cread - cwrite, 0) * price_input + cread * COALESCE(pcr, price_input)               + cwrite * COALESCE(pcw, price_input) + outp * price_output) / 1e6) AS cost_usd   FROM cand WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY target_provider ) SELECT scenario, CAST(cost_usd AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd FROM base UNION ALL SELECT scenario, CAST(cost_usd AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS cost_usd FROM per_prov WHERE array_contains(:param_sim_providers, target_provider) ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_provider_kpis
queryLines: WITH ref AS (SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_aa_model_ref),
real AS (
SELECT event_date, destination_model, SUM(input_tokens) inp, SUM(output_tokens) outp,
SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite
FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name))
AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ra AS (SELECT r.*, ref.intelligence ri, ref.price_input pin, ref.price_output pout,
ref.price_cache_read pcr, ref.price_cache_write pcw
FROM real r JOIN ref ON r.destination_model = ref.slug_norm),
equiv AS (SELECT destination_model, pi, po, pcr2, pcw2 FROM (
SELECT m.destination_model, ep.price_input pi, ep.price_output po,
ep.price_cache_read pcr2, ep.price_cache_write pcw2,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.destination_model
ORDER BY ABS(ep.intelligence - m.ri), ep.intelligence DESC) rn
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT destination_model, ri FROM ra) m
JOIN ref ep ON ep.provider = :param_sim_provider) WHERE rn = 1)
, dm AS (SELECT ra.destination_model,
(GREATEST(inp-cread-cwrite,0)*pin + cread*COALESCE(pcr,pin) + cwrite*COALESCE(pcw,pin) + outp*pout)/1e6 rc,
(GREATEST(inp-cread-cwrite,0)*e.pi + cread*COALESCE(e.pcr2,e.pi) + cwrite*COALESCE(e.pcw2,e.pi) + outp*e.po)/1e6 sc
FROM ra JOIN equiv e USING (destination_model))
SELECT CAST(SUM(rc) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS real_cost,
CAST(SUM(sc) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost,
CAST(SUM(sc) - SUM(rc) AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS savings FROM dm

datasets.name: ds_provider_daily
queryLines: WITH ref AS (SELECT * FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_aa_model_ref),
real AS (
SELECT event_date, destination_model, SUM(input_tokens) inp, SUM(output_tokens) outp,
SUM(cache_read_input_tokens) cread, SUM(cache_creation_input_tokens) cwrite
FROM perdomo_demos_catalog.ai_savings.v_model_usage_daily
WHERE (size(:param_workspace) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_workspace, workspace_name))
AND event_date BETWEEN :date_range.min AND :date_range.max
AND (size(:param_models) = 0 OR array_contains(:param_models, destination_model))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ra AS (SELECT r.*, ref.intelligence ri, ref.price_input pin, ref.price_output pout,
ref.price_cache_read pcr, ref.price_cache_write pcw
FROM real r JOIN ref ON r.destination_model = ref.slug_norm),
equiv AS (SELECT destination_model, pi, po, pcr2, pcw2 FROM (
SELECT m.destination_model, ep.price_input pi, ep.price_output po,
ep.price_cache_read pcr2, ep.price_cache_write pcw2,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.destination_model
ORDER BY ABS(ep.intelligence - m.ri), ep.intelligence DESC) rn
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT destination_model, ri FROM ra) m
JOIN ref ep ON ep.provider = :param_sim_provider) WHERE rn = 1)
, dm AS (SELECT ra.event_date, ra.destination_model,
CAST((GREATEST(inp-cread-cwrite,0)*pin + cread*COALESCE(pcr,pin) + cwrite*COALESCE(pcw,pin) + outp*pout)/1e6 AS DECIMAL(38,2)) cost_usd,
(GREATEST(inp-cread-cwrite,0)*e.pi + cread*COALESCE(e.pcr2,e.pi) + cwrite*COALESCE(e.pcw2,e.pi) + outp*e.po)/1e6 sc
FROM ra JOIN equiv e USING (destination_model)),
daily_sim AS (SELECT event_date, SUM(sc) day_sim FROM dm GROUP BY 1)
SELECT dm.event_date, dm.destination_model, dm.cost_usd,
CAST(ds.day_sim AS DECIMAL(38,2)) AS sim_cost_usd
FROM dm JOIN daily_sim ds USING (event_date) ORDER BY dm.event_date
